gates.observed_reason: One or more implementation clauses remain proposed, started or merely implemented.
gates.requirement: Every originating requirement has an explicit lifecycle disposition and evidence appropriate to the pre-freeze state; no embedded pre-freeze must-have is unclassified or merely accepted, and post-freeze requirements are identified as external finalization obligations.

gates.observed_reason: All 24 research-package files (23 content hashes plus the integrity manifest) and the separately hashed Claude DOCX are present.
gates.requirement: The 24-file research package (23 content artefacts plus its integrity manifest) retains its recorded hashes and 40 successful checks, and the Claude evaluation is separately integrity-bound.
OKF 0.2, YAML-LD semantic round-trip, JSON-LD/RDF equivalence, SHACL, JSON Schema and vocabulary competency checks pass.
All publicly accessible in-scope source routes have frozen acquisition evidence and exact denominators; restricted routes are declared.

gates.observed_reason: The official-effects graph and the governed Codex v3 full-corpus terminal, independent-review, accepted-projection and zero-direct-API receipts pass their bound checks.
gates.requirement: The official effects graph is non-empty and queryable, live reconciliation is evidenced, and the governed Codex generator/reviewer workflow records exactly one unique terminal outcome for every one of the 365,786 eligible records with deterministic evidence checks, independent review and resumable integrity-bound receipts. The optional direct API profile is not a release prerequisite. GATE-05 status is derived from those artefacts and cannot be passed by this authored gate record alone.
A clean clone reproduces identical semantic and byte digests with pinned dependencies.
Chrome, Firefox and WebKit journeys pass, keyboard operation is verified, and automated WCAG checks have no serious or critical violations.
Initial transfer, cold and warm search latency, and browser-memory limits pass on the frozen candidate.
After the immutable RC release and archive exist, Pages, raw, RC archive and compatibility entry points pass unauthenticated smoke tests; the YAML-LD MIME exception remains explicit.

Secrets, dependencies, content injection, XML/XXE, archive bombs, SSRF, privacy, unsafe redirects/URLs, untrusted downloaded content, immutable-evidence handling and supply-chain checks pass on the frozen candidate.

The corpus-bound release suite has independently verified gold evidence, citation-bearing executed answers, zero hard failures, at least 85/100 for every critical persona/task family, and two successful held-out challenge passes.

gates.observed_reason: The checksum-bound embedded release report records exact relationship composition, coverage and snapshot currency, unresolved gaps, licence/access escalations, executed evaluation, model cost and the YAML-LD MIME exception.
gates.requirement: The final release report records relationship composition, coverage, freshness, gaps, licence/access escalations, evaluation results and model cost.

The release candidate is promoted without rebuilding; the RC and final tags peel to the frozen commit, their immutable API observations are integrity-bound, and both public assets equal the sealed archive bytes.

All 63 originating requirements have item-level final evidence-backed passed, explicitly accepted deferred, externally blocked or superseded closure; no must-have is merely accepted and the immutable closure receipt is bound to the frozen ledger and commit.
